image.name: Just my words
image.blurb: No styling added. Your prompt as written.

image.name: Photoreal
image.template: {prompt}. Photorealistic photograph, natural lighting, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, sharp focus, true-to-life colors, fine detail.

image.name: Cinematic still
image.template: Cinematic film still: {prompt}. Anamorphic widescreen, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, rich color grade, subtle film grain.

image.name: Studio portrait
image.template: Professional studio portrait of {prompt}. Soft key light with gentle rim light, seamless backdrop, 85mm lens, crisp skin texture, magazine quality.

image.name: Product shot
image.blurb: Ad-ready packshot on a clean set.
image.template: Commercial product photography of {prompt}. Clean minimal set, softbox lighting, subtle reflections, high-end advertising look, crisp detail.

image.name: Anime
image.template: Anime key visual of {prompt}. Clean line art, cel shading, vivid colors, detailed background, dynamic composition.

image.name: Storybook
image.template: Warm storybook illustration of {prompt}. Gouache and watercolor textures, soft edges, charming details, gentle palette.

image.name: Fantasy art
image.template: Epic fantasy concept art of {prompt}. Painterly, atmospheric lighting, grand sense of scale, highly detailed.

image.name: Poster & text
image.template: Graphic poster design: {prompt}. Bold typography rendered clearly and spelled exactly, strong layout, print-ready.

edit.name: Anything
edit.placeholder: Make it nighttime with the street lights on

edit.name: New background
edit.blurb: Keep the subject, swap the scene.
edit.template: Replace the background with {prompt}. Keep the main subject exactly the same, matching the lighting to the new scene.
edit.placeholder: a sunny beach at golden hour

edit.name: Restyle
edit.blurb: Repaint in a different art style.
edit.template: Redraw this image in the style of {prompt}, keeping the same composition and subjects.
edit.placeholder: an oil painting with thick brushstrokes

edit.name: Remove something
edit.template: Remove {prompt} from the image and fill the area naturally so it looks untouched.

edit.name: Add something
edit.blurb: Place a new object into the scene.
edit.template: Add {prompt} to the image, matching the perspective, lighting and style.
edit.placeholder: a red vintage bicycle leaning on the wall

edit.name: Change outfit
edit.template: Change the person's clothing to {prompt}. Keep their face, pose and the background the same.

edit.name: Change text
edit.template: Change the text in the image to read "{prompt}", keeping the same font style and placement.

edit.name: Restore photo
edit.blurb: Fix an old or damaged photo.
edit.template: Restore this photo: remove scratches, dust and damage, sharpen details and correct faded colors. {prompt}
